```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggh4x)

get_predictions <- function(path, ending){
  file_paths <- sort(list.files(path, pattern = paste0("\\.", ending, "$"), full.names = TRUE))
  file_names <- sub(paste0("\\.", ending, "$"), "", basename(file_paths))
  data_list <- lapply(file_paths, read_csv)
  names(data_list) <- file_names
  combi <- data_list %>% imap_dfr(~ .x %>% mutate(source = .y)) %>% mutate(label = tolower(label))
  colnames(combi)[[1]] <- "Drug"
  return(combi)
}

process_all <- function(dataset){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust", "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  dataset %>% 
    mutate(organism = ifelse(str_detect(source, "virus"), "virus", "human")) %>%
    mutate(dataset = case_when(
      str_detect(source, "hvidb") ~ "HVIDB",
      str_detect(source, "intact") ~ "IntAct", 
      .default = "Open Targets"
    )) %>%
    mutate(method = str_extract(source, method_pattern))
}

process_filtered <- function(dataset){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust", "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  dataset %>%
    mutate(organism = ifelse(str_detect(source, "virus"), "virus", "human")) %>%
    mutate(dataset = case_when(
      str_detect(source, "hvidb") ~ "HVIDB",
      str_detect(source, "intact") ~ "IntAct", 
      .default = "Open Targets"
    )) %>%
    mutate(filter = case_when(
      str_detect(source, "top_100") ~ "top_100",
      str_detect(source, "top_50") ~ "top_50",
      str_detect(source, "same_n") ~ "same_n"
    ))%>%
    mutate(method = str_extract(source, method_pattern))
}

drugs_bca <- read_csv("data/DrugVirus.csv")
drugs_bcc <- read_tsv("data/DrugVirus_combi.tsv")
```

```{r}
make_druggability_plot <- function(data,
                                    id_col,
                                    category_cols,
                                    rank_col = NULL,
                                    id_order = NULL,
                                    rank_low_is_better = TRUE) {

  cat_labels <- names(category_cols)
  tier_rank  <- setNames(seq_along(cat_labels), cat_labels)

  if (!is.null(id_order)) {
    ids <- unique(id_order)
  } else if (!is.null(rank_col)) {
    rank_sort <- data %>%
      select(id = all_of(id_col), rank = all_of(rank_col)) %>%
      distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      filter(!is.na(rank)) %>%
      arrange(desc(rank))
    ids <- unique(rank_sort$id)
    leftover <- setdiff(unique(data[[id_col]]), ids)
    ids <- c(ids, leftover)
  } else {
    ids <- unique(data[[id_col]])
  }

  long <- data %>%
    select(id = all_of(id_col), all_of(category_cols)) %>%
    rename(!!!setNames(category_cols, cat_labels)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cat_labels), names_to = "category", values_to = "raw") %>%
    mutate(checked = !is.na(raw) & raw != FALSE & raw != 0 & trimws(as.character(raw)) != "")

  long <- long %>%
    mutate(rank_val = tier_rank[category]) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(highlight = checked & rank_val == suppressWarnings(min(rank_val[checked], na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      highlight = replace_na(highlight, FALSE),
      id       = factor(id, levels = ids),
      category = factor(category, levels = rev(cat_labels))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(id))

  p_main <- ggplot(long, aes(x = id, y = category)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = highlight), color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = filter(long, checked), label = "\u2713", size = 3.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey85", `FALSE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 9),
      axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5)
    )

  legend_df <- tibble(
    x = c(1, 3.1),
    y = 1,
    label = c("highest evidence\nlevel", "category supported"),
    type  = c("square", "check")
  )
  p_legend <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_tile(data = filter(legend_df, type == "square"),
              fill = "grey85", width = 0.2, height = 0.35, color = "white") +
    geom_text(data = filter(legend_df, type == "check"), label = "\u2713", size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = x + 0.15, label = label), hjust = 0, size = 3.2, lineheight = 0.9) +
    xlim(0.5, 5.5) + ylim(0.5, 1.5) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 2, 5))

  combined <- p_main / p_legend
  combined + plot_layout(heights = c(length(cat_labels), 0.6))
}
```

```{r}
intersect_predictions <- function(predictions, known_drugs){
  predictions %>%
    inner_join(known_drugs, by = "Drug", suffix = c("_pred", "_known"))
}

all_hits <- bind_rows(
  intersect_predictions(corona_all, corona_drugs) %>% mutate(disease = "SARS-CoV-2"),
  intersect_predictions(hsv_all,    hsv_drugs)    %>% mutate(disease = "HSV-1"),
  intersect_predictions(hiv_all,    hiv_drugs)    %>% mutate(disease = "HIV-1")
)

all_nested <- all_hits %>%
  group_by(disease, organism, dataset) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    data = map(data, ~ arrange(.x, desc(score)))
  )

filtered_hits <- bind_rows(
  intersect_predictions(corona_filtered, corona_drugs) %>% mutate(disease = "SARS-CoV-2"),
  intersect_predictions(hsv_filtered,    hsv_drugs)    %>% mutate(disease = "HSV-1"),
  intersect_predictions(hiv_filtered,    hiv_drugs)    %>% mutate(disease = "HIV-1")
)

filtered_nested <- filtered_hits %>%
  group_by(disease, organism, dataset, filter) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    data = map(data, ~ arrange(.x, desc(score)))
  )
```

```{r}
all_nested <- all_nested %>%
```

```{r}
recall_pooled <- bind_rows(
  recall_results_pooled_clinical %>% mutate(set = "Clinical Trial"),
  recall_results_pooled_approved %>% mutate(set = "Approved"),
  recall_results_pooled_all  %>% mutate(set = "All"),
)

recall_all <- bind_rows(
  recall_results_clinical %>% mutate(set = "Clinical Trial"),
  recall_results_approved %>% mutate(set = "Approved"),
  recall_results_all  %>% mutate(set = "All"),
)

methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust", "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
viruses <- c("SARS-CoV-2", "HIV-1", "HSV-1")
sets <- c("Clinical Trial", "Approved", "All") 
combis_map <- tibble(
  organism = c("human", "human", "human", "human", "virus", "virus", "human", "human" , "human"),
  dataset = c("HVIDB", "IntAct", "IntAct", "IntAct", "HVIDB", "IntAct", "Open Targets", "Open Targets" , "Open Targets"),
  filter = c("unfiltered", "top_100", "top_50", "same_n", "unfiltered", "unfiltered", "top_100", "top_50", "same_n")
)

full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(
  virus = viruses,
  set = sets,
  combis_map
)

full_combos_methods <- tidyr::crossing(
  virus = viruses,
  set = sets,
  method = methods,
  combis_map
)
joiner = c("virus", "set", "organism", "dataset", "filter")
joiner_method = c("virus", "set", "organism", "dataset", "filter", "method")

recall_pooled_filtererd <- full_combos %>% 
  left_join(recall_pooled, by = joiner) %>% 
  mutate(recall = ifelse(is.na(recall), 0, recall)) %>%
  mutate(set = factor(set, levels = c("All", "Clinical Trial", "Approved")))

recall_filtered <- full_combos_methods %>% 
  left_join(recall_all, by = joiner_method) %>% 
  mutate(recall = ifelse(is.na(recall), 0, recall)) %>%
  mutate(set = factor(set, levels = c("All", "Clinical Trial", "Approved")))
```


```{r}
virus_colors <- c("SARS-CoV-2" = "#F6656A", "HSV-1" = "#31ABE8", "HIV-1" = "#00D100")

recall_pooled_filtererd %>%
  mutate(organism = recode_values(organism, "human" ~ "Human Seeds", "virus" ~ "Viral Seeds")) %>%
  mutate(filter = recode_values(filter, "unfiltered" ~ "initial", default = filter)) %>%
  mutate(filter = factor(filter, levels = c("initial", "same_n", "top_50", "top_100"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = recall, y = set, fill = virus)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = ~ filter(.x, recovered != 0),
            aes(label = recovered), hjust = -0.3) +  
  facet_nested(organism + dataset + filter ~ virus, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = virus_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.19))) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(y = "Method", x = "Recall") 
ggsave("plots/drugs/recall_pooled.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 6)


```
